title: ISDA CDS Standard Model and Standard CDS Contract Converter Specification
locator: Documentation page and linked 'ISDA Standard CDS Contract Converter Specification' (version May 5, 2009), Functionality and Specification, printed p. 1: standardized conversion between spread and upfront using trade date, maturity, notional, standard coupon, recovery rate, discount inputs, and either spread or upfront; output is the converted upfront or spread and cash settlement amount. The site states that the standard model is intended to align fixed-coupon/upfront calculations and standardized spread/upfront translation.
licenseNotes: Link and paraphrase only; this lesson does not reproduce or claim full implementation of the ISDA model.
